regularBasis: A$2.21/L: RACQ Brisbane September 2026 monthly ULP91 average, published 7 October. A dated benchmark, not today’s pump price.
premiumBasis: A$2.38/L: estimated premium-95 planning rate. September ULP91 A$2.210 plus the September-quarter 95–91 price gap (A$2.161 − A$1.992) = A$2.379, rounded. No observed September monthly PULP95 figure was available.
homeBasis: A$0.30/kWh is illustrative. AER’s 2026–27 Energex flat residential standing-offer usage cap is 27.9744c/kWh including GST. Existing household daily supply charges are excluded from additional vehicle charging.
publicBasis: A$0.65/kWh is illustrative, not a Queensland average or maximum. Operators publish location/session prices in their apps. Idle fees and subscriptions are excluded.
